ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1809503562000}, the Moon is still in {S:0} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.
